message.thaumicexploration.chest_first: Binding created. Use this seal on another empty chest.
tc.research_page.TX.CHEST.1: Apply the same seal to two empty single chests. They share one inventory, accessible to golems and hoppers.
tc.research_page.TX.URN.1: The urn is an unlimited source of water. It fills nearby cauldrons and crucibles when its top is clear. A pipe can draw water from the top.
tc.research_page.TX.SEALS.1: Blank seals are the basis for chest and jar bindings. Imbue them with essentia in a crucible.
tc.research_page.TX.JAR.1: Apply the same seal to empty, unlabelled warded jars. They share one reserve of essentia.
tc.research_page.TX.FLOATCANDLE.1: These candles float without support and stabilize an infusion altar when arranged symmetrically.
tc.research_page.TX.TRASHJAR.1: A low-suction jar that destroys one unit of essentia every six ticks. Attach a tube above it to dispose of excess essentia.
tc.research_page.TX.TALISMANFOOD.1: This talisman absorbs food from your hotbar and the first slot of your inventory, then replenishes your hunger and saturation as needed.
tc.research_page.TX.METEOR.1: Jump while sneaking to launch forward. Press sneak again in midair to dive and create a blast on landing. The boots prevent fall damage.
tc.research_page.TX.COMET.1: The boots accelerate as you run and freeze nearby water into temporary ice. They also improve jumping and reduce fall distance.
tc.research_page.CAP_sojourner.1: Hold the wand to draw vis from nearby aura nodes. The cap leaves at least one unit of each aspect in the node. The cap uses 95% of the normal vis cost.
tc.research_page.CAP_mechanist.1: The cap draws vis faster while you point the wand at an aura node. It uses 95% of the normal vis cost.
tc.research_page.ROD_amber.1: This rod stores 10 vis of each primal aspect and restores one of each every five seconds.
tc.research_page.ROD_amber_staff.1: An amber staff stores 25 vis of each primal aspect and restores one of each every five seconds.
tc.research_page.ROD_transmutation.1: Stores 75 vis of each primal aspect. Above 90% capacity, excess vis is converted into less abundant aspects at a 4:1 ratio.
tc.research_page.ROD_transmutation_staff: Stores 175 vis of each primal aspect and redistributes excess vis like the transmutative wand rod.
tc.research_page.TX.REPLICATOR.1: Use a supported block on the replicator to set a sample. Activate it with a wand or redstone. It draws essentia from nearby jars to create a copy.
tc.research_page.TX.BRAINCURE.1: Infusion purifies a zombie brain for use in the Think Tank.
tc.research_page.TX.THINKTANK.1: Place the tank on a bookshelf with space around it. Feed it books to recover knowledge fragments. Enchanted books are more productive.
tc.research_page.TX.BELT.1: When equipped in the belt slot, it grants full knockback resistance.
tc.research_page.TX.RINGS.1: Each ring reduces the vis cost of its primal aspect by three percentage points when worn.
tc.research_page.TX.DREAMCATCHER.1: Carry it in your hotbar or first inventory slot for a 75% chance to ward off taint damage.
tc.research_page.TX.TAINTCHARM.1: Protects against taint poison. Away from tainted lands, it feeds on tainted goo or tendrils. Removing the charm from reach can be fatal.
tc.research_page.ROD_necromancer_staff.1: Stores 200 vis of each primal aspect. It absorbs nearby vis orbs at increased yield but retains only three quarters of ordinary vis gains.
tc.research_page.TX.TENTACLE.1: Wear the ring to summon an allied tentacle when you take damage while standing on solid ground. The tentacle attacks nearby monsters.
tc.research_page.TX.SORTER.1: Select the sorter with a golem bell. Sneak and use the bell on the input inventory. Use it normally on destinations, then place an example item in each destination. The sorter routes matching items to those inventories.
tc.research_page.TX.SOULBRAZIER.1: Supply Mortuus essentia from below and Ignis vis from a relay network. Activate with an empty hand to temporarily move your permanent warp into the brazier. It spreads taint while active. When the fuel runs out, the warp returns.
message.thaumicexploration.brazier_owner: Only the owner can activate the brazier.
message.thaumicexploration.brazier_activ: A brazier is already holding your warp.
message.thaumicexploration.brazier_fuel: The brazier needs Mortuus essentia and Ignis vis.
tc.research_text.TX.TALISMANFOOD: Stores food and feeds you automatically
tc.research_text.TX.METEOR: Launch forward and strike the ground
tc.research_text.ROD_transmutation: Convert surplus vis into other aspects
tc.research_text.TX.RINGS: Reduce the vis cost of a primal aspect
tc.research_text.TX.TAINTCHARM: Trade protection for dependence on taint
tc.research_text.ROD_necromancer_staff: Draw more vis from fallen creatures
tc.research_page.TX.EVERBURN.1: Connect the urn to a vis relay network. Each unit of Ignis produces 250 mB of lava. Collect it with a bucket or a pipe from above.
tc.research_page.TX.CRUCSOULS.1: Leave space above the crucible. It drains nearby creatures and produces essentia and flux. Attach essentia tubes to its sides or underneath.
tc.research_text.TX.ENCHANT.binding: Slows targets and blocks teleportation at level II.
tc.research_page.TX.ENCHANT.binding.1: Slows targets and blocks teleportation at level II.
tc.research_text.TX.ENCHANT.disarming: Can disarm creatures on a melee hit.
tc.research_page.TX.ENCHANT.disarming.1: Can disarm creatures on a melee hit.
tc.research_text.TX.ENCHANT.night_vision: Grants night vision while wearing the enchanted helmet.
tc.research_page.TX.ENCHANT.night_vision: Grants night vision while wearing the enchanted helmet.
